Position Summary:
Are you obsessed with body care? Do you live for the cultural moment, the brand world, and the kind of storytelling that makes people feel something and then buy something? Do you want to build a brand, not just run a campaign?
Naturium is seeking an Associate Director, Brand Marketing – Body Category to define and drive the global brand strategy and go-to-market vision for our body care portfolio. This is a high-impact role for a brand world builder, someone who can construct the creative and strategic architecture that makes a category feel inevitable, then activate it with precision across markets and channels.
You will own the global brand identity for Naturium body: what it stands for, how it speaks, and where it shows up. You will set the go-to-market vision, shaping how the body brand lands with consumers at every touchpoint from retail floors to cultural conversations. Reporting to the Global Brand Lead, this role operates at the highest level of brand thinking while remaining deeply connected to how strategy converts to real-world brand resonance.

Global Body Category Brand Strategy

- Develop brand positioning, messaging frameworks, and creative territories that are distinctly ownable for body

- Identify whitespace opportunities in the body category and consumer landscape that the brand can meaningfully own

- Serve as the global brand authority for body the final word on how the brand shows up across every market, channel, and partner

- Shape the cultural brand calendar identifying tentpole moments, cultural conversations, and brand-right opportunities that bring the body world to life

- Shape the strategic narrative for how the body brand enters, shows up, and wins in the US retail environment across mass, specialty, and DTC

- Set the strategic direction for key retail brand moments with partners ensuring the body brand shows up with power and coherence at every touchpoint

- Manage and optimize regional marketing investment across campaigns, launches, and activations, ensuring strong ROI and disciplined financial stewardship

- Define brand health metrics and success criteria that measure the strength of the body brand world, not just campaign outputs

- Leverage consumer, cultural, and competitive intelligence to continuously sharpen brand strategy and GTM vision

- Build clear, compelling brand narratives for leadership that connect brand equity building to long-range business growth

- Mentor junior brand talent and cultivate a team culture defined by strategic rigor, creative ambition, and brand obsession

The Campaign Manager, e.l.f. Brands will develop and execute bold, insight- driven 360° marketing campaigns across e.l.f. brands. This role sits on the Brand Marketing team and is responsible for bringing integrated campaigns to life across all key channels (digital, social, ecommerce, influencer, retail, and paid media), ensuring cohesive storytelling and consistent brand expression across multiple brands and audiences.

You’ll play a key role in how our brands show up in culture —supporting campaign planning from concept through execution, helping manage marketing calendars, and collaborating cross-functionally to ensure every activation is on-brand, on-time, and built to spark conversation and community engagement.

This is a hands-on role for a campaign marketer who thrives in the details, loves turning strategy into action, and is energized by the pace and creativity of a culture and entertainment led brand.

- Support the development and execution of integrated 360° marketing campaigns, aligning with brand objectives and business priorities.

- Help bring campaigns to life across digital, social, ecommerce, influencer, retail, experiential, and paid media channels—ensuring cohesive storytelling and consistent brand expression across every consumer touchpoint.

- Contribute to creative brief development, translating brand strategy and consumer insights into clear, inspiring direction for creative and agency partners.

- Manage day-to-day campaign execution—from briefing through asset delivery, launch, and post-campaign review—keeping timelines, budgets, and quality on track.

Calendar Strategy & Planning

- Assist in managing the marketing campaign calendar, helping align key product launches, brand moments, seasonal activations, and cross-brand initiatives.

- Support 360° activation planning to amplify marketing moments, helping ensure all channels are in sync and cross-functional partners are aligned on deliverables.

- Balance multiple campaigns and brands simultaneously, prioritizing effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with cross-functional teams—including integrated marketing, digital marketing, creative, and connected commerce —to ensure seamless execution and alignment of brand messaging and objectives.

- Coordinate with external agency and production partners, briefing them effectively and ensuring deliverables meet brand standards and timelines.

Performance & Optimization

- Track and analyze campaign performance metrics, surfacing consumer, community, and channel insights to inform recommendations and optimizations.

- Support monitoring of brand health and engagement KPIs, using data to help refine strategies and improve campaign impact.

- Stay connected to community feedback and real-time trends, helping make agile adjustments to keep campaigns relevant and resonant.

Brand Integrity & Innovation

- Help maintain brand integrity, ensuring all campaigns are on-brand and aligned with each brand’s expression, values, and positioning.

- Proactively explore new and innovative marketing strategies, channels, and formats to drive brand awareness, engagement, and cultural
relevance.

- Bring a community-led, insight-driven approach to every campaign, helping turn cultural moments and consumer needs into marketing that moves people.
Requirements:

- 5+ years of experience in integrated marketing, campaign management, or brand marketing, with hands-on experience supporting and executing
360° campaigns from concept through execution.

- Experience executing multi-channel campaigns across digital, social, influencer, ecommerce, and retail.

- Strong understanding of the beauty industry and consumer trends; experience across multiple categories (color cosmetics, skincare, wellness) is a plus.

- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage timelines, prioritize tasks, and juggle multiple campaigns and brands simultaneously.

- Proven experience contributing to creative briefs and working with creative and agency partners to bring campaigns to life.

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable campaign optimizations.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross-functionally and supporting stakeholders across teams.
